name: Money Tracker
summary: Friendly phone-first money app (Copilot/Monarch feel): month switcher, a big Net number with in/out sparklines, a donut and breakdown by colour-coded category, a 6-month in/out bar chart, budgets with progress rings and over-budget warnings, repeating entries that add themselves on the right dates, search and filters, receipt photos, CSV import/export, JSON backup/restore and a printable month report with the owner's letterhead. Starts empty with a welcome card and a 'Try it with sample data' button.

sections.name: facts
sections.what: Hidden spans holding {{business}}, {{phone}}, {{email}}, {{address}}, {{year}}; app.js reads them for the top bar and the report letterhead
sections.edit: Leave as is; the tokens are filled in by the app

sections.name: view-home
sections.what: Home tab: month switcher, welcome card (only when there is no data), Net hero stat with a spent-of-income bar, Money in / Money out stats with deltas and sparklines, 'Where it went' donut + breakdown rows (tap a row to filter Activity), 'Last 6 months' bars, budget preview, Recent, Coming up, Month report button
sections.edit: Rewrite the welcome card words for the owner's trade; reorder or delete <section> blocks freely; keep the data-slot attributes app.js fills

sections.name: view-activity
sections.what: Activity tab: search (notes, categories, amounts), Month / All time, category select, chips (All, Money in, Money out, Receipts), entries grouped by day with day totals, Export these as CSV
sections.edit: Usually no change; rename chip labels if the owner uses other words (for example Sales / Costs)

sections.name: view-budgets
sections.what: Budgets tab: Left to spend hero with an even-pace marker, budget cards with rings (amber near the limit, red when over), alerts, list of categories without a budget

sections.name: view-repeat
sections.what: Repeating tab: monthly totals of repeating money in/out and the list of rules (every week, every 2 weeks, monthly with the 31st becoming the month's last day, yearly with Feb 29 -> Feb 28)

sections.name: view-settings
sections.what: Settings tab: currency, link to Categories, backup + restore (JSON), CSV export + import (bank exports work: Date/Amount or Debit/Credit columns, US or day-first dates), storage meter, load/clear sample data, erase everything

sections.name: view-categories
sections.what: Route #/data/categories: categories for money out and money in; each has a name, colour, icon and optional monthly budget
sections.edit: To change the starting categories edit DEFAULT_CATS in app.js (section 2), not this markup

sections.name: view-report
sections.what: Route #/home/report: printable month report (letterhead with {{business}}, {{address}}, {{phone}}, {{email}}; totals; money out by category with budgets; money in by category; every entry)
sections.edit: Keep the tokens; the footer line can be reworded

sections.name: form-txn
sections.what: Add / edit entry sheet: Money out / Money in, big amount box, category tiles, date, repeat, note, receipt photo
sections.edit: Field names are read by saveTxn() in app.js; keep them

sections.name: form-category
sections.what: Category sheet: name, kind, colour swatches, icon grid, monthly budget

sections.name: form-repeat
sections.what: Repeating entry sheet: kind, amount, category, name, how often, first date, last date, active switch, a live line explaining the schedule

behaviors: all data in browser storage through AK.store('expense-tracker') under the {{slug}} namespace; survives reloads; JSON backup/restore and CSV import/export in Settings
starts empty: welcome card + 'Try it with sample data' (entries say 'Sample ...', never future-dated) + 'Clear sample data' that keeps the owner's own entries
money is stored rounded to the cent (1.005 -> 1.01) and summed in whole cents (0.10 + 0.20 = 0.30)
repeating entries are added on their dates whenever the app opens or comes back to the screen; never duplicated; editing changes only future ones; pause/resume; optional last date
fair comparisons: while a month is running, Money in/out deltas compare with the same days of last month
budgets: rings and pills (On track, Ahead of pace, Almost used, Over by $X), Home banner when a budget is over
delete asks first, then offers Undo; deleting a used category asks where to move its entries
receipt photos via the phone camera or gallery (resized JPEG) with a viewer; a storage meter warns when the phone storage gets full
big numbers shrink to fit their card in every style; donut slices wear the category colours
printable month report with the owner's letterhead (AK.print) and a Copy summary button for messages
phone: bottom tabs + Add entry button; computer: sidebar, two-column dashboard, side sheets
style_notes: Works with every style; tested at 390 and 1280 with midnight-neon, clinical-clean, editorial-serif, soft-pastel, neo-brutalist and workshop-industrial (plus lint on all screens). Colours come from the kit through appkit tokens; category colours are fixed hues mixed with the ink colour so they read on light and dark backgrounds (lint's 'more than one accent colour family' warning is expected). Edit DEFAULT_CATS in app.js to fit the owner's trade (an auto shop can keep Parts & supplies, Tools & equipment, Fuel & vehicle). Change the app name in the <title> and AK.pwa() line if the owner prefers another word than 'Money'.
